As a researcher specializing in large language models (LLM), I would like to understand the recent development of the field of hallucination detection for LLMs. Please help me draft a literature review section in the style of NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR papers. The section should contain multiple paragraphs, where each paragraph illustrates the progression of a coherent line of research.
Requirements: (1) Only include papers published in top AI conferences and journals (ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, EMNLP, ACL, AAAI, COLING, COLM, TPAMI, TMLR, etc.). Do not include preprints from arXiv. (2) Focus specifically on the development of the field from 2023–2025.  (3) I would like to know empirical techniques (e.g., benchmarks, detection algorithms), theoretical, and interpretability works. (3) There is no restriction on tasks. You should at least cover common tasks such as summarization and open-ended QA.
